subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

__Unless we sat__ in an incorrect posture, we may strain our back.
solution:
The correct answer is: If we sit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'If' is used in sentences in which one thing only happens or is true when another thing happens or is true.
 
• In this context, it is said that if someone sits in an incorrect posture (one thing happens), he/she may strain his/her back (another thing happens).
 
• Also, the sentence is a **conditional sentence. **A conditional sentence begins with 'If'.
 
• If the condition is in the **present tense **(sit), then its result should be in the **future** (denoted by 'may').
 
• The incident that happens first or was supposed to happen first takes a **present tense** (sit) when ‘will/shall/can/may’ is present in the main clause (strain).

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***If we sit***__ in an incorrect posture, we may strain our back.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The three types of conditional sentences (with examples) are given in the table.

 
 

 I
 If I study
 I may pass the exam
 
 

 II
 If I studied
 I might pass the exam
 
 

 III
 If I had studied
 I might have passed the exam
